newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends steady, silver trims early gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends steady, silver trims early gains.

text.p: Gold prices held steady after opening at a higher level on Thursday because of poor enquiries, dealers said.
Gold was up by five rupees per 10 gramme on Wednesday.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 150 rupees higher at 60,450 rupees per piece, dealers said. They were up by 100 rupees per piece on Wednesday.
Silver opened higher but light profit-taking at the higher level trimmed early gains towards the close, dealers said.
Silver was up by 30 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
